variants.prompt: Framed by a sumptuous velvet drapery, she turns to face the camera with a playful, teasing smile, her long raven locks spilling over one shoulder as she glances over her shoulder, the soft focus of the DSLR lens blurring the lush greenery of an exotic garden into a dreamy, impressionistic backdrop, her crimson tunic and billowy white trousers clinging to her curves in the warm sunlight filtering through the leaves.
